observations.actual: Both [AC:spec-3-1] tests in tests/public-docs.test.ts passed (2 files, 39 tests, exit 0). They assert joycraft.release equals version, the summary is one line of at most 300 characters, releaseVersion equals version, and CHANGELOG.md has a "## 1.9.3 — " entry. Diff read: package.json version and joycraft.release 1.9.2 -> 1.9.3, summary replaced with one line about this release; src/joycraft-release.json releaseVersion 1.9.3; the test diff only appends [AC:spec-3-1] to the two [AC:release-fields] titles, no assertion change (class 1, as the spec allows). I checked the claims against payload: payload/.claude/agents/joycraft-reviewer.md names dispatch.md#start-a-native-dispatch, --help and the cd form; payload dispatch.md says a child cannot see its own agent ID; the implement skill says launch without host worktree isolation. I found no overclaim.
